mapper.sql: time_capsule_id, child_id, financial_account_id, title, status, expected_release_at, released_at, entry_count, total_contribution_amount, latest_entry_at, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at

tc.time_capsule_id, tc.child_id, tc.financial_account_id, tc.title, tc.status, tc.expected_release_at, tc.released_at, tc.entry_count, tc.total_contribution_amount, tc.latest_entry_at, tc.deleted_at, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at, fa.financial_goal_template_id, COALESCE(fa.goal_name_snapshot, fgt.goal_name) AS goal_name, fa.goal_target_amount, fa.goal_target_date
mapper.select: SELECT fa.financial_account_id, fa.owner_type, fa.owner_member_id, fa.child_id, fa.account_name, fa.account_product_type, fa.account_status, fa.link_status FROM financial_account fa WHERE fa.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId}

SELECT
FROM time_capsule tc INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = tc.financial_account_id LEFT JOIN financial_goal_template fgt ON fgt.financial_goal_template_id = fa.financial_goal_template_id WHERE tc.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId} AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO time_capsule ( child_id, financial_account_id, title, status, expected_release_at ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{financialAccountId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{expectedReleaseAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM time_capsule tc INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = tc.financial_account_id LEFT JOIN financial_goal_template fgt ON fgt.financial_goal_template_id = fa.financial_goal_template_id INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = tc.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE tc.time_capsule_id = #{timeCapsuleId} AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
FROM time_capsule tc INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = tc.financial_account_id LEFT JOIN financial_goal_template fgt ON fgt.financial_goal_template_id = fa.financial_goal_template_id INNER JOIN child_parent cp ON cp.child_id = tc.child_id AND cp.member_id = #{memberId} INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE tc.time_capsule_id = #{timeCapsuleId} AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT
FROM time_capsule tc INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = tc.financial_account_id LEFT JOIN financial_goal_template fgt ON fgt.financial_goal_template_id = fa.financial_goal_template_id WHERE tc.financial_account_id = #{financialAccountId} AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE time_capsule tc SET entry_count = CASE WHEN tc.entry_count > 0 THEN tc.entry_count - 1 ELSE 0 END, total_contribution_amount = GREATEST( tc.total_contribution_amount - #{contributionAmount}, 0 ), latest_entry_at = ( SELECT MAX(tce.contributed_at) FROM time_capsule_entry tce WHERE tce.time_capsule_id = tc.time_capsule_id AND tce.status != 'DELETED' ) WHERE tc.time_capsule_id = #{timeCapsuleId}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM time_capsule tc INNER JOIN financial_account fa ON fa.financial_account_id = tc.financial_account_id LEFT JOIN financial_goal_template fgt ON fgt.financial_goal_template_id = fa.financial_goal_template_id WHERE tc.child_id = #{childId} AND tc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN tc.expected_release_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tc.expected_release_at ASC, tc.created_at DESC, tc.time_capsule_id DESC
